item.title: Version 0.8.1
item.description:
0.8.1

  • "Notable" nudges are now a real macOS system notification instead of a custom panel; "Subtle" blinks the menu bar icon red.
  • Stats popover: a new "Erinnert" tab shows how often each app got nudged, today or over the last 7 days, scrollable up to 15 apps.
  • Recognizes 5 more dictation apps: Willow Voice, Voicy, BetterDictation, Dictato, Weesper.
  • Trial days remaining now show in the right-click menu, not just Settings.
  • Settings shows the running app version, and the Daten/Lizenz cards are more compact.
